title: Identification of novel inhibitors against Med15a KIX domain of Candida glabrata.
authors: Waseem, Mohd; Das, Shubhashis; Mondal, Debarati; Jain, Monika; Thakur, Jitendra K; Subbarao, Naidu
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过计算筛选和分子动力学模拟鉴定靶向光滑念珠菌Med15a KIX结构域的小分子抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作（KIX-Pdr1）而非直接TF-DNA结合，但KIX结构域与转录因子Pdr1互作机制及MD方法对TF相关互作建模有参考价值。
abstract: Candida glabrata, the second most common cause of invasive fungal infections, exhibits multi-drug resistance to commonly used antifungal drugs. To counter this resistance, there is a critical need for novel antifungals. This study identifies small molecule inhibitors that target a three-helix bundle KIX domain in the Med15a Mediator subunit of Candida glabrata (CgMed15a KIX). This domain plays a crucial role by interacting with the Pleiotropic Drug Resistance transcription factor Pdr1, a key regulator of the multidrug resistance pathway in Candida glabrata. We performed high throughput computational screening of large chemical datasets against the binding sites of the CgMed15a KIX domain to identify novel inhibitors. We selected six potential candidates with high affinity and confirmed their binding with the CgMed15a KIX domain. A phytochemical compound, Chebulinic acid binds to the CgMed15a KIX domain with a KD value of 0.339 muM and shows significant inhibitory effects on the growth of Candida glabrata. Molecular dynamics simulation studies further revealed the structural stability of the CgMed15a KIX-Chebulinic acid complex. Thus, in conclusion, this study highlights Chebulinic acid as a novel potential antifungal compound against Candida glabrata.
abstract_zh: 光滑念珠菌（Candida glabrata）是侵袭性真菌感染的第二大常见原因，对常用抗真菌药物表现出多重耐药性。为应对这种耐药性，亟需开发新型抗真菌药物。本研究识别出靶向光滑念珠菌Med15a中介体亚基中三螺旋束KIX结构域（CgMed15a KIX）的小分子抑制剂。该结构域通过与多效药物耐药转录因子Pdr1相互作用发挥关键作用，Pdr1是光滑念珠菌多重耐药通路的主要调控因子。我们针对CgMed15a KIX结构域的结合位点，对大型化学数据集进行了高通量计算筛选，以识别新型抑制剂。我们选出了六个具有高亲和力的潜在候选物，并确认了它们与CgMed15a KIX结构域的结合。一种植物化学化合物——鞣花酸（Chebulinic acid）以0.339 μM的解离常数（KD）与CgMed15a KIX结构域结合，并对光滑念珠菌的生长表现出显著抑制效果。分子动力学模拟研究进一步揭示了CgMed15a KIX-鞣花酸复合物的结构稳定性。因此，本研究强调鞣花酸作为针对光滑念珠菌的新型潜在抗真菌化合物。
